wire: disk-quota job -> du.total_size -> the quota warning

criteria.text: for a root (a str or os.PathLike) that names an existing directory, and a tree under it at most 100 levels deep in which every path is shorter than 1024 bytes, total_size(root) returns the sum of the sizes in bytes of every directory entry under root that is a regular file, or raises OSError if it cannot determine that sum
symbolic links under root are neither followed nor counted
